findings.claim: The CLI docs still say `localstack token` prints only a token and one newline. The new `token s3 ROLE` prints three export lines and a line on stderr, and no reference page mentions it.
The prefix test catches a mapped folder equal to viking://user/jasper/resources/, but not one above it, such as viking://user/jasper/. Row r3's fails_when also covers "contains resources/".
